title: Security hardening
notes: The phone setup and log pages now need the one-time key in the QR code, so others on your Wi-Fi can't open them
Your saved login is stored encrypted on the TV, and Android backup of app data is off
Updates are only accepted from this project's GitHub releases over a secure link, and are checked against a published fingerprint before installing

title: Catch-up fixes
notes: Resuming a pause never just sits there: it tries another recording link, then goes live with a message
Test catch-up recognises more stream types and reports each link format separately
Copy everything now works on the phone log page, plus a Select all button
When the provider says too many connections, the app waits 3 seconds and tries once more

title: Pause live TV, catch-up and faster switching
notes: Pause live TV with OK; on catch-up channels it resumes right where you paused
Rewind and forward live shows, start a show from the beginning, or go back to live
TV guide: go back up to 7 days and replay past shows (marked ↺)
Faster channel switching using a single stream, with timings in Diagnostics
Clear error messages with the provider's code, e.g. too many connections (509)
About: a card for Sparky, with ways to buy her a treat
Fixes: duplicate build number, first-refresh log line, double update download; cancelled loads no longer logged as errors

title: Subtitle style
notes: Settings → Subtitle style: size, text colour, background, edge (drop shadow or outline) and position
Live preview while you choose; also reachable from Audio & subtitles while watching
New default: medium white text with a drop shadow on a semi-transparent box
Raised position keeps subtitles clear of the bottom edge on letterboxed films

title: New movie and episode controls
notes: New TV-style control bar for movies and episodes that always responds to the remote
◀ / ▶ jump back / forward 10 seconds; hold to go faster. OK plays and pauses
▼ shows buttons: play/pause, back/forward 10 s, audio & subtitles, next episode, start over
One audio & subtitle setting for all movies and series; live channels remember up to 200 choices
Clear watch history also clears saved audio & subtitle choices

title: Audio and subtitles
notes: Live TV: press ▶ to choose the audio track and subtitles; your choice is remembered per channel
Movies and episodes: subtitles button and audio tracks in the player controls
Diagnostics shows how many channels offer catch-up, and for how many days

title: Faster start and live previews
notes: Opens in seconds: a compact saved library, and Home appears as soon as channels are ready
Movies and series finish loading in the background
Favorites and Recently watched pages show a live preview panel in list and tile view
Home: channel tiles play live (with sound) after a moment on them
Home rows are now Favorites, Recently watched, Recently added
Full-screen TV: Left or Back returns to the page you came from; a short OK press does nothing
Safe margins so nothing is cut off at the edges of the TV

title: Home, regions, favorites and recents
notes: New Home screen: recently watched, favorite channels, continue watching and new movies as tiles
My regions: choose the regions you watch once (US, India…); change or reset anytime in Settings
Group lists are organized under region headings, with cleaner channel names
Provider divider rows (##### NEWS #####) now show as headings instead of channels
LIVE / NEXT badges on event channels
Favorites and Recently watched pages in the side menu, with a tile or list view
Full-screen TV: OK opens a channel list over the video; Left or Back returns to the channel list
Playlist updates automatically once a day, with the last update time in Settings
TV guide: slimmer rows for channels without guide information
Favorites now use a heart

title: Guide filters
notes: TV guide: one-press Favorites filter
TV guide: choose any channel group from a list (also changes the group in Live TV)

title: Built for very large playlists
notes: Uses far less memory with hundreds of thousands of titles
New 'Preparing your library' step so the loading screen never looks stuck at 100%
Shows 'Opening your saved library' when starting from the saved copy

title: Faster first load
notes: Large playlists load about twice as fast: each list is now read only once

title: Reliable loading, progress, and one-click updates
notes: Fixed: the app could close while loading very large playlists
New loading screen shows each step, megabytes downloaded and item counts
Each section loads on its own, so one failing list no longer stops the rest
Updates: the app checks for new versions and installs them with one click
Diagnostics page with an activity log you can open on your phone
If the app ever closes unexpectedly, the error is shown on the next launch

title: First release
notes: Live TV with channel groups, logos, live preview and now/next info
Favorites: hold OK on any channel, movie or series
TV guide grid with a live 'now' line
Movies and Series with resume, start over and next episode
Search across channels, movies and series
Set up from your phone by scanning a QR code
About page with release history
